label: May 24, 2026
headline: Rubio launches "AppUS" — new America First visa scheduling tool
summary: Prioritises business professionals who strengthen US-India commercial ties. Announced during Rubio's first India visit as Secretary of State.

label: May 23, 2026
headline: Green Card applicants must return to home country to apply
summary: US government announces that those seeking a Green Card must now return to their home countries to file — a major shift affecting thousands of Indian applicants.

headline: Kolkata launches priority B1/B2 slots for parents 50+
summary: US Consulate Kolkata now offers priority visitor visa appointments for eligible Indian parents aged 50 and above visiting children in the US.

label: Sep 2025
headline: Interview waiver eliminated for work & student visas
summary: H-1B, H-4, L-1, F-1, J-1, O-1 applicants no longer qualify for interview waiver. All must attend in-person interviews.

label: Dec 2025
headline: Social media screening expanded to employment visas
summary: Adds ~30 min per case, slashing daily appointment capacity by nearly half. Backlogs expected through Q2 2026.
